integrity: Exact analytic proofs with standalone symbolic reproducibility. No claims of outside authorship, certification or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The proven sharp threshold is confined to real affine preconditioners on a 3x3 Jordan block and first standard left-Arnoldi compressions; finite arithmetic, other dimensions, other polynomials and broad performance claims are excluded. A related three-dimensional Ritz-localization article was accessible only in abstract form.
title: A sharp affine-preconditioning barrier for inverse-square-root Arnoldi on a three-dimensional Jordan block
